newsitem.title: USA: NYSE to suspend, delist English China Clays.
newsitem.headline: NYSE to suspend, delist English China Clays.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said trading of the American depositary receipts of English China Clays Plc will be suspended as of the close of trading today.
Following suspension, NYSE said it would apply to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to delist the issue.

The exchange said it was taking the action because the company's number of shareholders in the U.S. had fallen below 400. It was advised by the companyof its intention to delist its securities in the U.S., NYSE said.
